endorsements.name: Brandon Niemczyk
endorsements.label: Probabilistic Spying on Encrypted Tunnels
endorsements.description: At the network layer, encrypted tunnels are typically seen as black boxes. Network traffic however, leaks side channel information that can often be analyzed to determine what the tunnel is being used for and the type of content being sent over it. Probabilistic algorithms will be explored that can analyze this side channel information and identify application protocols within the tunnel. An open-source toolkit containing the algorithms/attacks presented will be released.
endorsements.subtitle: Black Hat Usa 2014

povs.explanation: The speaker’s proposal was accepted through the conference’s independent review process. They publicly presented and defended the work at the event, providing verifiable and recognized evidence of the endorsement. We could not verify whether the work is used in industry in situations of real consequence.
